title: Prepositions with Pronouns and Verb Collocations
lede: Build compact forms such as فِيهِ and إِلَيْهَا, then learn verbs with the prepositions they naturally require.

items.feedback: The pronoun attaches to the transformed stem إِلَيْـ.

items.prompt: Which verb normally takes a direct object without إِلَى?
items.feedback: زار directly governs the person or place visited.
مَعَهُمْ is the company form; بِهُمْ has a different function.
على becomes عليـ before the pronoun.

items.prompt: Replace الْمَدْرَسَةِ in ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ.
items.feedback: المدرسة is feminine; retain the preposition إلى.

items.prompt: Replace الْكِتَابِ in بَحَثْتُ عَنِ الْكِتَابِ.
Replace الصَّدِيقَاتِ in ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ الصَّدِيقَاتِ.
items.feedback: A feminine human plural takes ـهُنَّ.
Non-human plural information is grammatically feminine singular; retain بـ.
Person with = مع; topic about = عن.

items.prompt: Replace الْحَدِيقَةِ in ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ.
Replace الْكُتُبِ in بَحَثْتُ عَنِ الْكُتُبِ.
items.feedback: Non-human plural is grammatically feminine singular.

options: Add إلى after every verb of movement or contact.
items.feedback: The usable unit is the whole collocation.

games.e: إلى becomes إليـ before the pronoun.
على becomes عليـ before the pronoun.

games.p: Replace الْمَعْلُومَاتِ in بَحَثْتُ عَنِ الْمَعْلُومَاتِ.
games.e: Retain عن; المعلومات is feminine singular in agreement.

blocks: ## Why this matters
Attached pronouns make Arabic concise, while accurate collocations prevent sentences that are grammatically possible-looking but unnatural.
### Core
Recognise forms with ـه، ـها and ـهم.
### Develop
Use full pronoun families and verb–preposition pairs.
### Stretch
Contrast direct objects with governed prepositional complements.
[callout] Communication target: Avoid repetition by replacing a known noun with the correct attached pronoun.
## Diagnostic start
Use meaning and the visible stem to identify each form.
## How pronouns attach
A preposition and attached pronoun form one written word.

TABLE: Base | him / it m. | her / it f. | them m./mixed | Meaning family // فِي | فِيهِ | فِيهَا | فِيهِمْ | in // إِلَى | إِلَيْهِ | إِلَيْهَا | إِلَيْهِمْ | to / towards // عَلَى | عَلَيْهِ | عَلَيْهَا | عَلَيْهِمْ | on / upon // عَنْ | عَنْهُ | عَنْهَا | عَنْهُمْ | about / away from // مِنْ | مِنْهُ | مِنْهَا | مِنْهُمْ | from // مَعَ | مَعَهُ | مَعَهَا | مَعَهُمْ | with / in company // لِـ | لَهُ | لَهَا | لَهُمْ | for / to / possession // بِـ | بِهِ | بِهَا | بِهِمْ | with / by / using
[callout] Notice the stem: إِلَى and عَلَى become إِلَيْـ and عَلَيْـ before attached pronouns: إِلَيْهِ، عَلَيْهَا .
[callout/warning] Pronunciation and writing: Write one word. Do not separate إِلَى هَا or invent عَلَاهُ .
## Replace the repeated noun
First identify the preposition; then attach a pronoun matching the known noun.
[ar] ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا أَمْسِ.
[ar] تَحَدَّثْنَا عَنِ الرِّحْلَةِ. تَحَدَّثْنَا عَنْهَا طَوِيلًا.
[ar] الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ. هُوَ عَلَيْهَا.
[ar] ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي. قَضَيْتُ الْيَوْمَ مَعَهُمْ.
[callout] Reference check: The pronoun agrees with the noun it replaces, not with the English word “it”. الْمَكْتَبَةُ is feminine, so use إِلَيْهَا .
## Verb–preposition collocations
Treat each pair as one vocabulary item.

TABLE: Verb + preposition | Meaning | Model // ذَهَبَ إِلَى | go to | ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى الْمَطَارِ. // وَصَلَ إِلَى | arrive at / reach | وَصَلْتُ إِلَى الْفُنْدُقِ. // عَادَ مِنْ | return from | عَادُوا مِنَ السَّفَرِ. // بَحَثَ عَنْ | look/search for | أَبْحَثُ عَنْ عَمَلٍ. // تَحَدَّثَ عَنْ | talk about | تَحَدَّثْنَا عَنِ الْبِيئَةِ. // تَحَدَّثَ مَعَ | talk with | تَحَدَّثْتُ مَعَ الْمُعَلِّمَةِ. // اِسْتَمَعَ إِلَى | listen to | أَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى الْأَخْبَارِ. // فَكَّرَ فِي | think about / consider | أُفَكِّرُ فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ. // اِهْتَمَّ بِـ | be interested in / care about | نَهْتَمُّ بِالصِّحَّةِ. // شَارَكَ فِي | take part in | شَارَكْتُ فِي الْمُسَابَقَةِ. // اِعْتَمَدَ عَلَى | depend/rely on | نَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى التِّقْنِيَّةِ. // اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى | need | أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى وَقْتٍ.
[callout] One verb, two meanings: تَحَدَّثَ عَنْ introduces the topic; تَحَدَّثَ مَعَ identifies the person spoken with.
## Direct object or preposition?
Not every English “to” or “for” becomes an Arabic preposition.

TABLE: Correct Arabic | Avoid | Reason // زُرْتُ صَدِيقِي. | زُرْتُ إِلَى صَدِيقِي. | زار takes a direct object // سَأَلْتُ الْمُعَلِّمَ. | سَأَلْتُ إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِ. | سأل takes a direct object // سَاعَدْتُ أُخْتِي. | سَاعَدْتُ لِأُخْتِي. | ساعد takes a direct object // اِنْتَظَرْتُ الْحَافِلَةَ. | اِنْتَظَرْتُ لِلْحَافِلَةِ. | انتظر takes a direct object // أَجَبْتُ عَنِ السُّؤَالِ. | أَجَبْتُ السُّؤَالَ in this target pattern | أجاب عن is the taught collocation
[callout/warning] Translation trap: English syntax does not decide Arabic syntax. Store the Arabic verb with its complement pattern.
## Misconception and proofreading clinic
Repair stem, reference and collocation errors.

TABLE: Incorrect | Correct | Why // ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى هَا. | ذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا. | attach pronoun and change stem // الْمَدْرَسَةُ قَرِيبَةٌ. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ. | الْمَدْرَسَةُ قَرِيبَةٌ. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا. | pronoun agrees with المدرسة // أَبْحَثُ إِلَى عَمَلٍ. | أَبْحَثُ عَنْ عَمَلٍ. | بحث عن // زُرْتُ إِلَى الْمُتْحَفِ. | زُرْتُ الْمُتْحَفَ. | زار takes a direct object
## Grammar game
Match each verb, meaning or pronoun form with its natural completion.
## Skills workshop التَّطْبِيقُ الْعَمَلِيُّ
Use compact pronoun forms and collocations in messages, gap fills and spoken answers.
[ar] قَرَأْتُ عَنِ الْمَسَابَقَةِ، ثُمَّ شَارَكْتُ فِيهَا.
[ar] تَحَدَّثْتُ مَعَ مُعَلِّمِي عَنِ الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ، وَاسْتَمَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ بِعِنَايَةٍ.
### Write a connected account
Write 80–100 Arabic words about a project, club, journey or school event. Refer back to people, places and things with attached pronouns instead of repeating every noun.
[callout] Success checklist: Use five verb–preposition collocations; use four attached preposition–pronoun forms; include one direct-object verb correctly without an unnecessary preposition.
[callout] Paper route: Underline verb–preposition pairs once and circle attached pronoun forms. Check what each pronoun refers to.
## Final mastery check
Check pronoun attachment and natural verb–preposition combinations.
### What you can now do
- Attach pronouns to common prepositions.
- Recognise high-frequency stem changes such as عَلَيْهِ and إِلَيْهَا.
- Learn verbs together with their required prepositions.
- Avoid adding a preposition to verbs that take a direct object.
Spaced revisit: Return in two or three days and complete the final check again without looking at the tables.
